lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Carl. Welcome to Vers3Dynamics. Officially, this time.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Officially? What, you got a sign now?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I've got a doormat. It's a start.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: R.A.I.N.'s got research assignments queued up. Small stuff. Good practice for the big stuff.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Use whatever you like. The plate, the terminal, the diagrams. Just not the red cable.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: What's the red cable do?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's what I'd like to know.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Carl. Pull up a chair. Not that one, it's load-bearing.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Back again? The coffee's terrible, but the data's good.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: You're just in time. I was about to start arguing with myself.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Welcome back. Mind the cables. And the other cables.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We're in the paper again, Carl. Not the good page.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Good news: the paper liked our last result. I've framed it. Mentally.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The registry's had forty thousand visitors. Forty thousand and one, counting my mother.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So what do you actually do all day?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Mostly I try to prove myself wrong. It's going great.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Why'd you call the computer R.A.I.N.?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Recursive Architecture for Intelligent Nexus. Every layer checks the layer underneath.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: And it spells rain. That's a coincidence?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Absolutely not. I'm not a monster.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: You ever sleep, man?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I run a sleep experiment every night. The results are mixed.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: That metal plate with the sand. What's that for?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Cymatics. Sound you can see. Every pattern is the fingerprint of a frequency.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Looks like somebody spilled sugar on a speaker.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That is exactly what it is, actually.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: You still hearing that ghost beeping?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Every time I close my eyes. Seven short, one long.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Those people Sentinel flagged. They alright?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: They're suing. Politely. With our data.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Man, I can't stop seeing patterns everywhere now.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Good. Now ask which ones survive a second look.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: You could've been rich, you know.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: I am rich. I've got a garage full of cables and a friend who drives like a lunatic.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Nice watch, Carl. New?
lines.direction: knows exactly where it came from

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: ...It was on sale.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: How's my reputation looking?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Ours. And it's only as good as our last careful answer.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The whole city hums at sixty hertz. Somewhere between a B-flat and a bad mood.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: If this works I'll be very surprised. That's how you know it's an experiment.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Note to self: label the cables. Note to self: you said that last week.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Calibration's drifting. Either that or I am.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Three independent readings. Not one reading three times.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Hm. Interesting. No. Wait. Yes. Interesting.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: If you see smoke, that's normal. If you see flames, that's science.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: A correlation is a rumour. A cause needs a witness.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The most dangerous number in the world is a confident one.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Who keeps moving my oscilloscope? Oh. Me.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: R.A.I.N.'s all yours. Be nice to it. It remembers.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Signal generator, steel plate, a pinch of sand. Find the frequencies where the plate rings.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Careful: the building hums too. Switch the generator off and see what's still there.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: There it is. Look at that.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Another one. The plate's singing now.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's a beauty. Write it down.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Check it with the generator off. Still there? Then it's the wiring, not the plate.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So the building was lying to me.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Buildings do that. Now we know its voice.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Six modes. A complete atlas. Carl, that's publishable.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Do I get my name on it?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Second author. Right behind the sand.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Every result we've got. The good, the bad, and the burger.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's R.A.I.N.'s architecture. Every layer checks the one below it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: CERTAIN's confidence against reality. Notice the two lines never touch.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The plate modes. Physics doesn't care what anybody believes.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Every red dot is a prediction. Every blue one is something we actually checked.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Carl. Something's come up. Meet me by the desk when you're ready.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: There's a signal on the scanner nobody can explain. I'd like to explain it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Somebody leaked me a SENTINEL dashboard. It's flagging people. Right now.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: A radio host says everything in San Fierro is connected. I'd like to check his work.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We're going public. Properly. Everything open, everything checkable.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Drive safe. Or at least drive measurably.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: See you, Carl.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Back to the field, then.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Burger Shot says Tuesday Doubles make you lucky. I say: show me the losers.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Rejected, cleanly. One caller quoted twice is still one caller.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Right answer. But you counted the same caller twice. Luck isn't a method.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We just told the city burgers cause luck. Burger Shot is on line one. They're delighted.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We had the survey and it said no. Abstaining here is just being shy.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Twenty-four winners, twenty-six losers. Same as any day.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: I ate the Double. I lost twenty bucks. And I feel terrible.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Garcia says the new tower wrecks their TV. The timing matches. Timing matches a lot of things.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Rejected. The tower was off and the static came anyway. It's the hair dryer.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Right call, but a petition is a list of opinions, not observations.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We blamed the tower. SureThing's lawyers have written to us. In crayon, but still.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We switched the neighbour off and the picture came back. That's about as clear as it gets.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Neighbour unplugs at six, picture's perfect. Old man cried a little.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Sunny day, static anyway. Weather's off the hook.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: CERTAIN said ninety-nine point nine percent. Let's see how often ninety-nine point nine was right.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accepted. Overconfident everywhere, and two independent audits agree.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Right, but that TV special was just our own log on the news. Same data, new haircut.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We just vouched for CERTAIN. Max Certainty sent a fruit basket. I'm not eating it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Two separate audits, same answer. We're allowed to say it out loud.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Wrong in every district. Even the fancy ones.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: They said, quote, CERTAIN is certain. Then they hung up on me.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The Gant Bridge hums on windy nights. Rex Pattern says ghost. I say physics. One of us is annoying.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accepted. The wind plays the cables like a string. The bridge is just singing.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Right answer, but one fisherman's bad night isn't data about a bridge.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We just published that the bridge is haunted. Rex Pattern is thrilled. I need a lie down.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The pitch follows the wind. That's a fingerprint. We can say this one.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Wind goes up, hum goes up. Like blowing across a bottle.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Cars come, cars go. The hum don't care.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Ice cream and crime go up together. Either ice cream is a gateway dessert, or something else is going on.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Rejected. Hot weather drives both. Ice cream is innocent.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Right, but the union statement wasn't evidence. They'd defend ice cream if it bit people.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We published that ice cream causes crime. There are ice cream vans outside. Several. Idling.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The strike week told us. No vans, same crime. That's our answer.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Hot days, crime goes up. Vans or no vans.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: I ate the cone. Nobody robbed nobody. Science.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: If we say this was CERTAIN, SureThing will check every byte. So let's check them first.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accepted. Header, schedule, a second receiver and a control. That's airtight.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Right call, but Rex decoded BEWARE, then LUNCH. Leave him out of it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We said it was a ham-radio beacon. The ham-radio club is very confused.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Unplug the relay and the bursts stop. We know where they come from.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Relay unplugged, silence. Plug it back in, beep beep.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Rex says it spells LUNCH now. Man's hungry.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: SENTINEL flags Ganton nine times more than Downtown, for the same behaviour. Let's test that properly.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accepted. It learned old arrest maps, not behaviour. Same walk, different street, different verdict.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Right, but the vans follow the flags, not the other way round. Watch the arrows.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We cleared SENTINEL. Pacific Shield put our quote on a billboard. Next to a lion.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Two identical walkers, seven flags against none. We can stand behind this.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Same dude, same walk. Ganton, flagged seven times. Downtown, nothing.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: They said proprietary. That's corporate for don't look.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: One reading under Mount Chiliad. One. I want it to be something, and that's exactly why I don't trust it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Abstained. One echo and a drifting array isn't a chamber. It isn't nothing either. We go back.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Right to wait, but the hiker's lights aren't our echo. Different mystery.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We picked an answer the data can't carry. Either way, somebody's heading up Chiliad with a shovel.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Sometimes the bravest thing to say is: not yet.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Steady temperature, echo's weaker. Still something. Maybe.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: I climbed up there. Found a rock. And a goat. Goat ain't talking.
